_comment: Copy this file to restore.config.json and fill in your tenant values. restore.config.json is gitignored and must never be committed.

source._comment: backupPath: full path to the backup snapshot folder produced by Export-M365TenantConfig. This is the folder that contains metadata.json, e.g. C:\M365Backup\output\contoso.onmicrosoft.com\20260428-120000

scope._comment: mode: 'Workload' (restore selected workloads) | 'File' (restore specific files) | 'Object' (restore specific named objects). Start with 'Workload' and disable workloads you don't want to restore.

workloadObjectTypes._comment: Per-workload apply toggles live in separate files at scope.workloadObjectTypesPath. Override specific object types here, e.g. add "Intune": { "Scripts": true } to restore only Intune scripts.

target._comment: mode: 'SameTenant' (restore to source tenant) | 'AnotherTenant' (cross-tenant restore — also fill in remap block). tenantName and tenantId must match the target, not the source.

authentication._comment: Credentials for the restore app registration (needs ReadWrite permissions). clientId = App (client) ID from Entra ID portal. certificateThumbprint = thumbprint of cert in Cert:\CurrentUser\My or Cert:\LocalMachine\My.

compareAuthentication._comment: Optional. Read-only app used ONLY for the compare-snapshot export phase. If omitted, the restore app above is used for both phases. Recommended: reuse your backup app here to avoid granting write permissions twice.

execution._comment: stopOnError: stop the restore run on first workload failure. force: suppress per-object [Y/N] confirmation prompts (equivalent to passing -Force on the command line — use for unattended/CI runs).

prechecks._comment: Pass -SkipPrechecks on the command line to bypass all checks for one run.

report._comment: outputRoot: where restore reports (HTML, JSON, Markdown, logs) are written. A timestamped subfolder is created per run.
